title: Startup Name Checker input
description: Give name ideas in **Keywords** (they are combined with every TLD) and/or finished names in **Domains**. At least one of the two is required. Rows for names on a TLD that does not exist are returned but never charged.

domains.title: Domains
domains.description: Finished domain names to check, one per line, for example example.com. Website URLs and email addresses are reduced to their domain; www. is dropped. Entries that are not a domain are skipped and saved to INVALID_INPUTS. Leave empty if you only use Keywords.

keywords.sectionDescription: Use this instead of, or as well as, a finished domain list. Each keyword is combined with every TLD, and with any prefixes or suffixes you add.
keywords.title: Keywords / names
keywords.description: Name ideas without a TLD, one per line, for example rentguitar or Solar Pet (spaces are removed, letters, digits and hyphens only). Each is combined with every TLD below, and with any prefixes and suffixes. Required if Domains is empty.

tlds.title: TLDs for keywords
tlds.description: TLDs to combine with Keywords, without the leading dot, for example com, io, ai. Only used with Keywords. Default: com. A TLD that is not in the IANA root zone list (for example zz) gives rows with status invalid_tld, which are not charged.

prefixes.title: Prefixes (optional)
prefixes.description: Optional. Words placed before each keyword, for example get, try, my, giving getrentguitar.com. Each prefix adds one more variant per keyword and TLD.

suffixes.title: Suffixes (optional)
suffixes.description: Optional. Words placed after each keyword, for example hq, app, online, giving rentguitarhq.com. Each suffix adds one more variant per keyword and TLD.

onlyAvailable.title: Return only available domains
onlyAvailable.description: When on, only names with status available are written to the dataset (rows for registered, unknown and invalid_tld names are left out). Names with status likely_available are left out too unless you switch on Include likely-available names. Default: off.

includeLikelyAvailable.title: Include likely-available names
includeLikelyAvailable.description: Only matters together with Return only available domains. A name on a real TLD that has no public RDAP registry and no DNS record gets status likely_available (available is null: DNS says it does not exist, but the registry could not confirm it). Those rows are left out when Return only available domains is on, unless you switch this on. Default: off.

lookupRegistered.title: Registration details for taken domains
lookupRegistered.description: When on, names that DNS shows as registered are also looked up at the registry (RDAP) to add registrar, creation date, expiry date, age and status codes. Slower, because registry lookups are throttled. Default: off.

maxDomains.title: Max domains per run
maxDomains.description: Safety cap on how many names are checked in one run. Default 5000, allowed 1 to 50000. Names beyond the cap are not checked. 1,000 name ideas times 3 TLDs is 3,000 names, which fits the default.

concurrency.title: Concurrency
concurrency.description: How many DNS lookups run at the same time. Default 20, allowed 1 to 50. Registry (RDAP) lookups are throttled to about 3 per second per registry whatever this is set to.
